solutionSql:
SELECT status,
       CASE
         WHEN weight_kg IS NULL THEN 'unweighed'
         WHEN weight_kg < 1000 THEN 'light'
         ELSE 'heavy'
       END AS weight_band,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS shipments
FROM shipments
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

ambiguities.readingChosen: weight_band in alphabetical order: heavy, light, unweighed.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Logical band order: light, heavy, unweighed (or unweighed first). Same rows in a different order.

notes: There are 11 status and band groups whose counts sum to 240, the full shipment count. Only the band order is ambiguous.
